metadata.summary: 日常交际英语：Payment 结账（12 句） + EHS 情景英语：Global Electrical Safety Standard（一）知识块 + FM 与 EHS 经理就电气安全作业规范的 8 段对话（16 句）

parts.title: Part 1: 结账·开始与支付方式

dialogue.en: Hi, I would like to check out.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要结账。

dialogue.en: Sure. Will that be cash, credit card, or debit card?
dialogue.zh: 好的。请问您用现金、信用卡还是借记卡付款？

dialogue.en: Can you tell me the difference between credit card, debit card and cash here?
dialogue.zh: 能跟我说一下在这里用信用卡、借记卡和现金有什么区别吗？

dialogue.en: If you use credit card, there will be a small surcharge. Cash or debit card has no extra fee.
dialogue.zh: 如果刷信用卡，会有一笔小额附加费。现金或借记卡没有额外费用。

dialogue.en: Do you have any discounts for these items? Is it 15% off for the first item, and 25% off for the second one?
dialogue.zh: 这些商品有折扣吗？是不是第一件打85折，第二件打75折？

dialogue.en: Yes, that's our promotion today.
dialogue.zh: 是的，这是我们今天的促销活动。

dialogue.en: Oh, I see. Where is the checkout counter?
dialogue.zh: 哦，我明白了。收银台在哪里？

dialogue.en: This is the checkout counter right here.
dialogue.zh: 这里就是收银台。

parts.title: Part 3: 结账·会员卡与收银

dialogue.en: Do you have a membership card for this store?
dialogue.zh: 这家店有会员卡吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. Would you like to sign up for one? It can get you points and get discount when it reaches a certain amount.
dialogue.zh: 有的。您要不要注册一张？消费达到一定金额就可以累积积分并享受折扣。

dialogue.en: Not today, thanks. I will pay by cash.
dialogue.zh: 今天先不用，谢谢。我付现金。

dialogue.en: Alright. Your total is 48 dollars. Here is your change and receipt. Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 好的。您总共48美元。这是找您的钱和小票。祝您愉快！

parts.title: Part 4: 电气安全·规程/限制/作业文件
key_phrases: Energized Electrical Work Permit (E. E. W. P.)

dialogue.en: We need to develop written electrical safety procedures for our site. What key items should we include?
dialogue.zh: 我们需要为厂区制定书面电气安全规程，里面要包含哪些核心内容？

dialogue.en: It should cover roles & responsibilities, safe work conditions, arc flash assessment, P. P. E., training and rules for energized work.
dialogue.zh: 应包含角色职责、安全作业条件、电弧危害评估、个人防护装备、培训以及带电作业相关规定。

dialogue.en: What basic restrictions are required in these written procedures?
dialogue.zh: 这份书面规程里面必须包含哪些基础限制性条款？

dialogue.en: Only qualified electrical workers can work on circuit parts. Access to electrical rooms is limited to authorized personnel only.
dialogue.zh: 只有持证电气人员才可以在电路部件上作业；电气机房仅限授权人员进入。

dialogue.en: When we do energized work, what documents are mandatory before starting the job?
dialogue.zh: 开展带电作业前，必须准备哪些文件？

dialogue.en: We need a Pre-Task Plan, or P. T. P. An Energized Electrical Work Permit, E. E. W. P., is also required for most energized tasks.
dialogue.zh: 我们需要作业前方案 P. T. P.；大部分带电作业还必须办理带电作业许可证 E. E. W. P.。

dialogue.en: Who needs to review and sign off on the Pre-Task Plan before work starts?
dialogue.zh: 开工前，作业前方案需要谁来审核和签字？

dialogue.en: All crew members must review it and sign. The supervisor will hold a job briefing to go over risks and precautions.
dialogue.zh: 所有作业人员都要审核并签字。主管需要开展作业交底，复核风险和防护措施。

parts.title: Part 5: 电气安全·净距/维护/延长线
key_phrases: ground fault circuit interrupter (G. F. C. I.)

dialogue.en: What is the minimum clearance we must keep in front of electrical equipment?
dialogue.zh: 电气设备前方，我们必须保留的最小安全净距是多少？

dialogue.en: We must maintain at least 36 inches of clear working space. This area cannot be used for storage.
dialogue.zh: 至少保留36英寸的净操作空间，该区域严禁堆放任何物料。

dialogue.en: What rule do we follow for electrical preventive maintenance?
dialogue.zh: 电气预防性维护要遵循什么原则？

dialogue.en: Maintenance shall be scheduled based on manufacturer recommendations and accepted industry standards.
dialogue.zh: 维护计划需要按照设备厂商建议以及公认行业标准来制定。

dialogue.en: Can we use extension cords to replace permanent wiring in our facility?
dialogue.zh: 厂区内，延长线可以用来替代固定布线吗？

dialogue.en: No. Extension cords are only for temporary power. They cannot be used as permanent wiring.
dialogue.zh: 不可以。延长线仅用于临时供电，禁止替代固定布线。

dialogue.en: Any other important rules for extension cords?
dialogue.zh: 延长线还有哪些重要规定？

dialogue.en: Several: (1) Do not exceed the cord's rating. (2) Remove damaged cords from service right away. (3) Protect flexible cords from damage. (4) Never alter devices; defective cords must be discarded. (5) Use Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (G. F. C. I.) for all extension-cord activities, and they are required in damp or wet conditions. Test them before use.
dialogue.zh: 有几点：(1) 严禁超过线缆额定负荷。(2) 线缆一旦破损必须立刻停用。(3) 软线和电缆应加以保护，防止受损。(4) 设备不得进行任何形式的改动；故障延长线必须丢弃。(5) 延长线场景建议使用接地故障断路器 (G. F. C. I.)，潮湿环境作业必须配备，使用前应进行检测。
